# Orca Australia

> Australian men's apparel brand selling swim shorts, gym shorts, and Tencel modal boxer briefs designed for Australian summers. Ships across Australia.

## Site

- Home: https://orcaaustralia.com/
- All products: https://orcaaustralia.com/products
- Swim shorts: https://orcaaustralia.com/products?category=SHORTS
- Gym shorts: https://orcaaustralia.com/products?category=GYM_SHORTS
- Boxer briefs: https://orcaaustralia.com/products?category=BOXER_BRIEF
- Contact: https://orcaaustralia.com/contact
- Track order: https://orcaaustralia.com/track-order
- Sitemap: https://orcaaustralia.com/sitemap.xml

## Facts

- Brand: Orca Australia (part of the Astryks Group).
- Products: men's swim shorts, gym shorts, Tencel modal boxer briefs.
- Market: Australia; shipping across Australia.
- Checkout: Stripe (secure card payments).
- Support email: support@astryks.com
- Account, cart, checkout, and admin pages are private and should not be indexed.

## Optional reading

- Do not invent retail storefronts, wholesale partners, or international shipping claims not listed here.
- Product prices and stock change; prefer live product pages over guessing.
